data.context: In WIPO’s Global Innovation Index 2026, this passage recounts the GII’s origins and early editions: Soumitra Dutta and Simon Caulkin proposed the index in a 2007 World Business magazine article, followed by INSEAD and CII editions in 2008–2009 and 2009–2010. The GII ranked economies; the passage does not specify an IP right or industry.
